sections.Profile:
White Shark, produced by Bell Coin Matic in 1979, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring artwork by Michele Martinelli. The game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, a five-bank drop target, four standup targets, a kick-out hole, and a spinning target. Notably, it was designed as a conversion kit for Europlay's 'Jaws' pinball machine, allowing operators to update existing cabinets with new gameplay and artwork.
